announcements.title: Memodex
announcements.body: Click on a cell and start playing that board immediately!

announcements.title: Solo badges
announcements.body: There was an error in the counting of the solo badges. This has been corrected.

body.en: The menu buttons now have colors. Prefer them plain? Turn it off under **User preferences → Theme**.
body.nl: De menuknoppen hebben nu kleuren. Liever zonder? Zet het uit bij **Gebruikersinstellingen → Thema**.
